title: Current settings and allocation
definition: Retain current regulatory settings and current service/compliance allocation. Not no policy.
required_causal_evidence: No intervention effect is inferred from surveillance.

title: Expanded cessation access and capacity
definition: Additional cessation provision, outreach and treatment access; service capacity and eligibility to be specified.
required_causal_evidence: Incremental quits, reach, substitution, sustained abstinence and delivery costs.

title: Youth prevention and age-of-sale compliance
definition: Prevention and compliance package with independently measured youth exposure/use.
required_causal_evidence: Youth initiation effects and costs; wastewater has no direct age label.

title: Risk-informed retail compliance
definition: Audit and compliance deployment under confirmed powers; no individual investigation triggered solely by a catchment signal.
required_causal_evidence: Detection, displacement, compliance effects and enforcement harms.

title: Border and supply-chain integrity
definition: Additional permitted supply-chain/border activity; deployment quantities and authority must be confirmed.
required_causal_evidence: Effect on supply, price, displacement, resource costs and social harms.

title: Combined cessation, prevention and integrity
definition: Joint service and enforcement package with non-additive effects and shared costs.
required_causal_evidence: Interaction effects, duplication and displacement.

title: Retail licensing and density reduction
definition: Prospective retailer licensing/density policy; not an existing approved-retailer scheme.
required_causal_evidence: Retail access effects, diversion and lawful/illicit substitution.

title: Very-low-nicotine smoked-tobacco standard
definition: Prospective VLNC standard, separately evaluated from birth-cohort and retail measures.
required_causal_evidence: Product nicotine/emissions, consumption intensity, quitting, illicit substitution.

title: Birth-cohort sales restriction
definition: Prospective restriction by birth cohort; age/date implementation explicit. Not a universal ban.
required_causal_evidence: Age-cohort adherence, initiation and supply displacement.

title: Endgame package
definition: Retail reduction plus VLNC plus birth-cohort restriction; distinct from total prohibition.
required_causal_evidence: Joint causal effects, compliance, intensity, substitution and organised-market response.

title: Endgame with cessation and supply safeguards
definition: Endgame plus explicit cessation, legal alternatives and targeted integrity resources.
required_causal_evidence: Joint effects and costs; do not add standalone benefits.

title: Total commercial smoked-tobacco supply ban
definition: Prospective ban on commercial sale, manufacture and import of smoked tobacco. No assumed possession offence; personal cultivation/stock exceptions require specification. NRT and vaping are not automatically prohibited.
required_causal_evidence: Enforcement, remaining lawful exceptions, illicit supply, substitution, cessation and criminal harms.

title: Total commercial ban with transition support
definition: NZ11 with explicit cessation and supply-integrity transition.
required_causal_evidence: Implementation, transition stocks, assistance, costs and adverse spillovers.

title: Excise freeze
definition: Freeze versus current indexation, for a specified period and real-price trajectory.
required_causal_evidence: Pass-through, own/cross-price elasticities, affordability and illicit response.

title: Additional excise escalation
definition: Additional real increase above indexation, separately by product.
required_causal_evidence: Tax elasticities, illicit entry, revenue and household impacts.

title: Excise reduction
definition: Reduction versus baseline with explicit magnitude and duration.
required_causal_evidence: Smoking uptake/cessation and illicit-to-legal substitution are both uncertain.

title: Heated-tobacco tax parity
definition: Remove relative HTP tax discount in a defined product-tax reform.
required_causal_evidence: HTP harm, cross-price substitution, consumption and retailer response.

title: Therapeutic-only vaping pathway
definition: Prospective channel restriction, not current NZ baseline.
required_causal_evidence: Access, cessation, relapse, youth uptake and illicit-vape substitution.

title: Cessation-oriented vaping access with youth safeguards
definition: Product/channel access package and specified youth safeguards.
required_causal_evidence: Adult switching and youth uptake; harms not inferable from total nicotine alone.

title: Regulated oral-nicotine pathway
definition: Prospective medicinal or other legally authorised pathway; approval status and access conditions must be specified.
required_causal_evidence: Product uptake, displacement, youth access and risk evidence.

title: School buffers and youth retail safeguards
definition: Prospective location/access controls; scope differs from broader retail-density restrictions.
required_causal_evidence: Youth access and substitution, not attribution from catchment concentrations.

title: Risk-differentiated tax/access package
definition: Coordinated product-specific tax/access and cessation package.
required_causal_evidence: Cross-product/channel demand, relative harms, interactions and equity.

title: Criminal-enterprise disruption package
definition: Permitted disruption of tobacco supply crime with explicit resource and harm accounts.
required_causal_evidence: Criminal activity/displacement, victim harms and justice costs; illicit volume is not a crime-cost coefficient.
